transcript:
Meeting header:
Date: 2027-06-09 | Time: 15:00 UTC | Duration: 48m
Location: Zoom
Attendees: Jasper Lee (Redwood AE), Priya Nair (Redwood SE), Marta Ruiz (Redwood CSM); Mike Chen (VP Procurement, Arclight), Laura Gomez (CISO), Ravi Patel (CTO), Anita Shah (Legal)

Summary:
Quick procurement kickoff to align on MSA/DPA redlines, SLA targets, pricing for dedicated capacity and next steps to get Arclight onboarded. SE asked for benchmarks and infra runbook. Legal had questions on indemnity, audit rights, and data residency.

Topics:
- MSA/DPA redline status
- SLAs (uptime, latency, credits)
- Pricing for Dedicated vs Hosted (commits/discounts)
- Security artifacts (SOC2, KMS, HSM)
- Onboarding timeline and next steps

Transcript:
[00:00] Jasper Lee: Hey everyone, thanks for joining. I'm Jasper from Redwood, I'll run the procurement side today, Priya our SE is on to cover infra and benchmarks. Marta from customer success here for onboarding.
[00:18] Mike Chen: Hi, Mike here. We got the initial MSA and DPA, thanks. Anita from legal is with me, and Laura our CISO. We're hoping to get through the open items.
[00:28] Anita Shah: Quick note on timing - procurement needs final legal by end of next week if possible.
[00:34] Jasper Lee: Yeah that should be doable, we can push a redline today, Priya will add the SLA appendix numbers.
[00:40] Priya Nair: Hi all - on the SLA side, just to set expectations, Redwood offers 99.9% uptime for Hosted with standard credits, and for Dedicated we can set custom SLOs depending on commit. There's also a regional failover option.
[01:00] Laura Gomez: For us uptime is critical but so is latency-consistency. We have a p95 requirement of 250ms for our interactive flows. Can Redwood meet that on hosted?
[01:12] Priya Nair: For typical models and smallish seqs we hit p95 ~180-220ms on hosted in us-west, but that depends on model and batching. For Dedicated we can guarantee lower tail latencies with reserved capacity; we'll share the p95 breakdown per model.
[01:36] Ravi Patel: When you say "model" - are you talking about open models, or Redwood-managed models? How's versioning handled?
[01:44] Priya Nair: Good Q. You can pin model versions in the API and we support both open models we host and customer-provided variants in Private deployments. Version pinning prevents unexpected regressions.
[02:02] Mike Chen: On DPA, Anita flagged the data residency clause. We need some language about EU data staying in eu-west-1 for our EU users.
[02:12] Jasper Lee: We can add a clause to route EU traffic to eu regions, for Hosted we can make a contract control to restrict region. For Private/VPC installs there's full control.
[02:24] Anita Shah: Also need to confirm encryption at rest - KMS is fine, do you support customer-managed keys?
[02:30] Priya Nair: Yes, we integrate with customer KMS and HSM for private deployments and offer bring-your-own-key for Dedicated in most clouds. We'll include the KMS section in the security appendix.
[02:44] Laura Gomez: Audit rights - do you provide logs and the ability to run a vendor security assessment?
[02:50] Jasper Lee: We provide audit logs and can share SOC 2 report, and we accept reasonable audit processes; for on-prem/private there are options for more granular log access.
[03:05] Anita Shah: On indemnity we have a standard carve-out request for open-source model IP claims - will you accept that?
[03:12] Jasper Lee: I can route that to our legal but generally we can accept narrow carve-outs; we'll mark that item.
[03:18] Marta Ruiz: I'll follow up with onboarding milestones - provisioning, contract sign, initial pilot and then production rollout.
[03:26] Mike Chen: Pricing - we need committed pricing for Dedicated, and a table showing per-token and per-embedding costs for Hosted.
[03:34] Jasper Lee: We'll send a pricing spreadsheet. To be transparent, Hosted is usage based; Dedicated has monthly reserved commit tiers with discounts. We'll include burst capacity options too.
[03:50] Ravi Patel: For benchmarks, we want a test at our expected load - 100 req/s with avg payload of ~1.2k tokens, and we want p50/p95 and cost per 1k tokens.
[04:02] Priya Nair: Understood. We'll run a benchmark on Dedicated profiles and Hosted to show differences. We'll attach the raw bench results and the methodology.
[04:15] Laura Gomez: What's your incident response SLA? If there's a degradations, what's the timeline?
[04:23] Jasper Lee: For Priority 1, our enterprise SLA has a 1-hour response target and a 4-hour mitigation window; we'll put exact definitions in the SLA appendix.
[04:36] Anita Shah: On data deletion - can you confirm data retention policy and delete-on-demand for logs?
[04:44] Priya Nair: We support configurable retention; for private/dedicated you can set zero retention if required. We'll document retention windows and deletion workflows.
[04:58] Mike Chen: A couple misc things - do you support SAML SSO for RBAC and SCIM provisioning?
[05:05] Jasper Lee: Yes SSO via SAML and SCIM are supported. We'll include the IdP configuration docs.
[05:12] Ravi Patel: Any dependencies on specific cloud provider features we should be aware of for Dedicated?
[05:18] Priya Nair: Mostly ephemeral - we use standard GPU instances and networking; for private we can tailor to your on-prem infra. We can provide an infra runbook.
[05:30] Anita Shah: Regarding MSA redlines, we've proposed some limitations on audit frequency and want to limit excessive audits - ok?
[05:38] Jasper Lee: That's reasonable; we'll propose a middle ground with advance notice and scoped audits.
[05:44] Marta Ruiz: Next steps - Jasper will send a consolidated redline and pricing, Priya will run bench- mark and send SLA appendix. Arclight legal will review and get back.
[05:56] Mike Chen: Sounds good. If we can get the redline by Monday and security docs this weekend, procurement can move quickly.
[06:06] Jasper Lee: We'll do our best to hit those dates. Anything else?
[06:10] Laura Gomez: One last Q on encryption in transit - TLS version minimum?
[06:15] Priya Nair: TLS 1.2+ support, we recommend 1.3. We'll include cipher list in the security appendix.
[06:24] Anita Shah: Also would like to see your data flow diagram for EU/US segmentation.
[06:29] Priya Nair: We'll attach a data flow and the routing rules.
[06:36] Jasper Lee: Great - I'll send the redline and pricing. Marta will kick off onboarding when contracts are signed. Thanks everyone.
[06:44] Mike Chen: Thanks all.
[06:46] (call ends)
